displayName: Store hero with cashback rate card
description: Hero for a single merchant page: logo + store name + category + giant cashback rate display in a side card + visit CTA + coupon count. Pair with CouponList below.

title.hint: Page H1 — defaults to store name.

cashbackRate.hint: Big rate value (e.g. '5%' or 'Up to 6%'). Renders as the side card.

rateNote.hint: Small caveat under the rate (terms, exclusions).

couponCount.hint: Active coupons. Renders below the description.

primaryCta.hint: Affiliate visit CTA — rel defaults to 'sponsored noopener'.

preview.description: Save on hotel bookings worldwide with cashback on eligible reservations. Verify final terms during checkout.
preview.rateNote: Cashback varies by hotel and booking type.
